name: Browser
description: Hearthscale's own Chromium as tools: the agent sees the page as numbered interactive elements, acts on them by number in front of you, signed in as you, and hands the tab over at a login wall.

tools.name: navigate
tools.title: Go to a URL
tools.description: Navigate the session's browser tab to a URL, opening the tab first when the session has none, wait for the page to settle, and return the page state. The page loads quietly in the background; the user sees it only after the show tool.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Web search
tools.description: Search the web for a query in the session's browser tab, opening the tab first when the session has none, and return the results page state. Prefer this over guessing a URL. The results load quietly in the background.

engine.description: The search engine; duckduckgo unless asked otherwise

tools.name: show
tools.title: Show the page
tools.description: Bring the session's browser tab in front of the user in the browser panel and return the page state. Call it only when the user asked to see the page in words like open it up, show it, pull up, or let me see. Never call it for a question the answer alone satisfies.

tools.name: go_back
tools.title: Go back
tools.description: Go back one page in the tab's history and return the page state.

tools.name: state
tools.title: Page state
tools.description: The page as the agent acts on it: the URL and title, the scroll position, then the visible content in order. Each interactive element is one line like [12]Pricing or [13]; click, input, scroll, dropdown_options and select_dropdown take that number. Plain lines are visible text. Only content near the viewport is listed; scroll to see more. Indices change on every state, so act on the latest one. Every action returns a fresh state, so call this only when the page may have changed by itself. The first read of an origin the user is signed in to asks once per origin.

tools.name: click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click the element with the given state index, wait for the page to settle, and return the page state.

index.description: The element index from the latest state

tools.name: input
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Type text into the input, textarea or editable element with the given state index and return the page state. The field is cleared first unless clear is false. Press Enter afterwards with send_keys when the form has no button.

index.description: The element index from the latest state

clear.description: Clear the field first; true unless given

tools.name: send_keys
tools.title: Send keys
tools.description: Send keyboard keys to the focused element: a key name like Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, ArrowDown, or a combination like Control+a or Shift+Tab; several keys separated by spaces run in order. Returns the page state.

keys.description: Key names, space-separated, with modifiers joined by +: "Enter", "Escape", "Control+a", "Shift+Tab"

tools.name: scroll
tools.title: Scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page, or the scrollable container around the element with the given state index, by a number of screens, and return the page state.

pages.description: How many screens to scroll; 1 unless given

index.description: An element index from the latest state; scrolls the container around it instead of the page

tools.name: find_text
tools.title: Find text
tools.description: Scroll the page to the first visible occurrence of a text and return the page state around it.

tools.name: search_page
tools.title: Search the page
tools.description: Find lines of the page's full visible text that match a pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive) and return them with their line numbers. Fast and complete; use it on long pages before scrolling.

pattern.description: A regular expression, or plain text, matched case-insensitively

max.description: At most this many matching lines; 30 unless given

tools.name: find_elements
tools.title: Find elements
tools.description: List the elements matching a CSS selector with their tag, text, attributes, and state index when they have one.

attributes.description: Attribute names to report; a sensible default set unless given

max.description: At most this many elements; 20 unless given

tools.name: dropdown_options
tools.title: Dropdown options
tools.description: List the options of the select or custom dropdown with the given state index.

index.description: The element index from the latest state

tools.name: select_dropdown
tools.title: Select an option
tools.description: Choose the option whose text matches in the select or custom dropdown with the given state index, then return the page state.

index.description: The element index from the latest state

tools.name: extract
tools.title: Extract the page
tools.description: The page's main content as Markdown, with headings, links, lists and tables kept. Long pages come in chunks; the result says where to continue with start.

start.description: The character offset to continue from; 0 unless given

tools.name: evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript
tools.description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its JSON-serialized result, capped for the context window.

js.description: A JavaScript expression to run in the page

tools.name: wait
tools.title: Wait
tools.description: Wait a number of seconds (at most 30) for the page to change, then return the page state.

seconds.description: How long to wait, at most 30

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: Capture the session's browser tab as an image, with every element of the last state boxed and labelled by its index.

tools.name: close
tools.title: Close the tab
tools.description: Close the session's agent-driven browser tab.
